name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
summary: Your wind rider carries cured hides from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff, high above the plains. The flight joins the Barrens to the Horde capital.

sections.title: Wings Across the Savannah
sections.body: Devrak carries travelers over the Barrens on a wind rider. For many, it is their first flight across Kalimdor. These wyverns link the young Horde’s scattered settlements and spare travelers the ground roads, where quilboar and centaur packs roam.

sections.title: Hides for the Armory
sections.body: Cured hides from the Barrens are bound for Ahanu, a craftsman at Hewa’s Armory in Thunder Bluff. He works beneath the great wind rider roost on the central mesa. Supplies from hunting outposts across the plains help him outfit local warriors and hunters.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Ride to Thunder Bluff?
aliases: where to start ride to thunder bluff
faq.answer: Devrak, the wind rider master at the Crossroads in the Barrens, offers passage to travelers carrying hides.

faq.q: Who is Ahanu and where can he be found?
faq.answer: Ahanu is a tauren artisan at Hewa’s Armory in Thunder Bluff, near the base of the city’s wind rider roost.

faq.q: What is being transported in this delivery?
faq.answer: You carry cured hides from the Barrens for Ahanu to use in leatherwork and armor crafting.

faq.q: Why use wind riders instead of walking?
faq.answer: Wind riders cross the Barrens to Thunder Bluff’s high mesas. They avoid the longer ground route through Mulgore and land at the city’s wind rider tower.

faq.q: Where does this delivery chain begin?
faq.answer: The delivery begins with Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads. He arranged the cured pelts in the earlier task, A Bundle of Hides.

faq.q: What comes next after delivering the hides?
aliases: followup to ride to thunder bluff
faq.answer: After receiving the hides, Ahanu sends you upstairs to speak with Tal, Thunder Bluff’s Wind Rider Master.

angles.text: As a young tauren returning from the Barrens, you can fly straight to the towering capital of your people.
As Horde, you rely on wind riders to link the Barrens outposts with the strongholds of Durotar and Mulgore.
